title: Redis: a worker exits when its primary becomes a replica (UNBLOCKED)
author: ChristianMurphy
body_preview: A Celery worker on `redis://` exits when its Redis node changes from primary to replica, as in a planned failover that keeps the old primary running. Redis ends the blocked `BRPOP` with `UNBLOCKED`, kombu lists that as a channel error, and the worker treats it as unrecoverable.
